project_type: pnpm monorepo - Node.js TypeScript fullstack app (React SPA + Express API + PostgreSQL)
build_system: pnpm workspaces with esbuild (api-server) and vite (creatools frontend)
test_framework: No test framework present - validation via typecheck and build
verification_instructions: Run pnpm run build to typecheck all libs then build all packages. The project has no unit tests but typechecking is strict.
setup_instructions: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && ensure DATABASE_URL env var is set
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. PostgreSQL database required (drizzle ORM with drizzle-kit push for migrations). No Docker verification needed - just typecheck + build.
contribution_requirements: Use existing patterns: drizzle schema in lib/db/src/schema/, routes in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/, pages in artifacts/creatools/src/pages/, shadcn/ui components, authFetch helper, requireAuth/requireAdminMiddleware for auth
key_patterns: Backend: Express 5 router pattern with typed req/res, JSON file storage for config (data/ dir), tik.tools API proxy pattern. Frontend: React with wouter router, shadcn/ui components, authFetch for API calls, useAuth context. Database: Drizzle ORM with pgTable, schema exports from lib/db/src/schema/index.ts. Admin panel: Single admin.tsx with section-based architecture (sections rendered conditionally). WebSocket: Client connects directly to wss://api.tik.tools with JWT from /api/tiktok/jwt endpoint.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm workspace with lib/ (shared packages) and artifacts/ (deployable apps). lib/db/ = Drizzle ORM schema + pool. artifacts/api-server/ = Express 5 API. artifacts/creatools/ = React SPA (Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui). artifacts/api-server/data/ = JSON config files (persisted settings).
